paragraphs.source_en: “Lord Sō,” Sōshitsu said, turning to Yoshitoshi, “very well—only when placed on the brink of death can one find a way to live. That way, I need not mention you or Lord Konishi to the Kampaku. I shall simply state my own opinion and then take my leave.”
